name: @crm/scraper
description: Scraper Google Maps (FastAPI + Playwright, Python 3.12) — appelé par le worker via HTTP (POST /scrape).

scripts.setup: python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: test -d .venv && .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q app || python3 -m compileall -q app
